reviews.text: I enjoy it. I really enjoy having it there a lot to go to whenever I feel like I’m unsure what’s happening with a situation and I would like a little insight or just fun each day. It’s not generalized or fake like many others. Sadly, it costs money to access many parts of it but it does have free things as well and I haven’t paid a dime yet and still enjoy it. I’d like a few more things to be available for free but that’s fine. I think one free clarifier card to narrow down your original reading would be nice instead you get the free original card and have to pay for a subscription if you want any clarification. Either way I still enjoy this app very much. I’m sure it would be awesome to have the subscription as well but I don’t have money for it right now.

Love this App. I have been impressed every time I do a reading. As I continue to use this app, the readings continue to be so on point. It’s almost scary. It’s amazing. They just continue where you you began your first reading and help and guide you to continue onto the path of your destiny making you aware of your feelings and possible obstacles and how to deal with those obstacles and understand those obstacles and move forward. I totally recommend this app and I think if you if you use it, you will be amazed. It’s it’s like getting counseling helping to ease your mind and sometimes clarifying when you’re in serious doubt or sometimes when you’re just feeling down and out, it provides options to be able to seek further information. I love this app. It’s my daily “vitamin” and check into it every day. It definitely helps me set the course for my day with new insight. 
I just felt the need to add to my previous review because it just keeps getting better and better. There were so many options to choose from, so many amazing options of how to seek your answers. Don’t think twice you will be absolutely amazed and intrigued and truly end up loving this app as I do. You will not be disappointed I promise you that.
